summary: Writes three consecutive DWORD fields of the receiver object from three parameters with a parameter-to-offset remapping: a2 into this+0x48 (this[18]), a3 into this+0x40 (this[16]), a4 into this+0x44 (this[17]). Returns the original this pointer. All three writes are unconditional and the function performs no guards and no other operations.

local_names.this: receiver object; DWORD array whose fields at offsets 0x40, 0x44, 0x48 are set by this function
local_names.result: the original this pointer, returned to the caller

operations.description: Returns the original this pointer (result = a1 at entry)

unresolved: The receiver object type and the meaning of the three set fields (offsets 0x40, 0x44, 0x48) are unknown
The parameter-to-offset remapping (a2 lands at 0x48, a3 at 0x40, a4 at 0x44) has no semantic explanation
